documents.title: Mass or Volume Air Flow Circuit Range/Performance Problem
documents.description: The engine control module detected that the mass airflow sensor readings are outside the expected range.

documents.title: Intake Air Temperature Sensor Circuit High Input
documents.description: The engine control module detected an abnormally high voltage signal from the intake air temperature sensor.

documents.title: Coolant Thermostat Temperature Below Regulating Temperature
documents.description: The engine is not reaching the expected operating temperature within the required time.

documents.title: Oxygen Sensor Circuit Malfunction Bank 1 Sensor 1
documents.description: The engine control module detected a malfunction in the oxygen sensor circuit.

documents.title: System Too Lean Bank 1
documents.description: The engine control module detected that the air-fuel mixture is too lean on bank 1.
possible_causes: Dirty or faulty mass airflow sensor

documents.title: System Too Rich Bank 1
documents.description: The engine control module detected excessive fuel or insufficient air in the air-fuel mixture.

documents.title: Injector Circuit Malfunction Cylinder 1
documents.description: The engine control module detected an electrical problem in the fuel injector circuit for cylinder 1.

documents.title: Cylinder 2 Misfire Detected
documents.description: The engine control module detected a misfire occurring in cylinder 2.

documents.title: Cylinder 3 Misfire Detected
documents.description: The engine control module detected a misfire occurring in cylinder 3.

documents.title: Cylinder 4 Misfire Detected
documents.description: The engine control module detected a misfire occurring in cylinder 4.

documents.title: Knock Sensor Circuit Malfunction
documents.description: The engine control module detected an electrical or signal problem with the knock sensor circuit.

documents.title: Crankshaft Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction
documents.description: The engine control module is not receiving a valid signal from the crankshaft position sensor.

documents.title: Camshaft Position Sensor Circuit Malfunction
documents.description: The engine control module detected an incorrect or missing signal from the camshaft position sensor.

documents.title: Exhaust Gas Recirculation Flow Insufficient
documents.description: The engine control module detected insufficient exhaust gas recirculation flow.

documents.title: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected Small Leak
documents.description: The vehicle computer detected a small leak in the evaporative emissions system.

documents.title: Evaporative Emission System Leak Detected Large Leak
documents.description: The vehicle computer detected a significant leak in the evaporative emissions system.

documents.title: Vehicle Speed Sensor Malfunction
documents.description: The vehicle control system detected an invalid or missing vehicle speed signal.

documents.title: Transmission Control System Malfunction
documents.description: The engine control module received an indication that the transmission control system has detected a fault.

documents.title: Input/Turbine Speed Sensor Circuit Malfunction
documents.description: The transmission control system detected an invalid signal from the input or turbine speed sensor.

documents.title: Torque Converter Clutch Circuit Performance or Stuck Off
documents.description: The transmission control system detected that the torque converter clutch is not operating as expected.
symptoms: Engine RPM remains high at cruising speed

documents.title: Crankshaft Position Camshaft Position Correlation Bank 1 Sensor A
documents.description: The engine control module detected that the crankshaft and camshaft position signals are not synchronized as expected.

documents.title: Fuel Rail/System Pressure Too Low
documents.description: The engine control module detected fuel pressure below the expected operating range.

documents.title: Engine Overboost Condition
documents.description: The engine control module detected turbocharger or supercharger boost pressure above the expected limit.

documents.title: Turbocharger or Supercharger Underboost Condition
documents.description: The engine control module detected that the turbocharger or supercharger is producing less boost than expected.

documents.title: Engine Coolant Temperature Sensor Circuit Low Input
documents.description: The engine control module detected a lower-than-expected voltage signal from the engine coolant temperature sensor.
symptoms: Engine overheating or incorrect temperature indication

documents.title: Random/Multiple Cylinder Misfire Detected
documents.description: The engine control module detected misfires occurring randomly or across multiple cylinders.

documents.title: Catalyst System Efficiency Below Threshold
documents.description: The vehicle computer detected that the catalytic converter may not be operating efficiently.

documents.title: Idle Control System RPM Higher Than Expected
documents.description: The engine control module detected that engine idle speed is higher than the expected value.

documents.title: ECM/PCM Processor Fault
documents.description: The vehicle computer detected an internal processor or control module fault.
